sections.name: Launch and Hearth
sections.purpose: Confirm installation, startup, orientation, and visible degraded states.
evidence_prompts: What did you expect on first launch?
guardrails: Do not enter credentials or personal manuscript content.

sections.name: Project Creation
sections.purpose: Create and reopen the disposable beta project through normal user surfaces.
evidence_prompts: Could you tell when the project was safely saved?
guardrails: Do not import a real manuscript.

sections.name: Smithy Editor
sections.purpose: Exercise ordinary editing, navigation, and recovery with synthetic prose.
evidence_prompts: Describe any lag, lost input, or unexpected navigation.
Could you recover from an intentional close/reopen?
guardrails: Use only the supplied synthetic prose.

sections.name: Foundry Structure
sections.purpose: Review chapter/scene structure and the visible status of local parsing.
evidence_prompts: Were required and optional services understandable?
Did any state appear complete when it was not?
guardrails: Do not bypass the UI with direct API or file manipulation.

sections.name: Export and Close
sections.purpose: Create a disposable export, close cleanly, and reopen the project.
evidence_prompts: Was the export location and completion state clear?
guardrails: Export only the synthetic beta project.
